title: Book 4 — Melpomene, Chapter 200
paragraphs: When the Persian forces sent by Aryandes from Egypt to help Pheretime had arrived at Barca, they laid siege to the city, proposing that the inhabitants hand over those guilty of the murder of Arcesilaus. But since all the people had shared in the guilt, they would not accept the terms. Then the Persians besieged Barca for nine months, digging underground passages leading to the wall and making vigorous assaults on it. The passages being dug were detected by a worker in bronze with a shield overlaid with bronze, who had devised a clever plan. Carrying the shield around inside the wall, he would apply it to the ground of the city; and whereas the other places where he applied it were silent, at those spots where digging was going on the bronze of the shield gave out a sound. The Barcaeans would then make a countermine there and kill the Persians who were tunneling. This was how the mines were detected, as I have said, and the attacks were repulsed by the men of Barca.
